title: Armor Targeting Evidence Pack (HGSOC pre-treatment CN structure → axis targeting)
ruo_disclaimer: Research Use Only. Not cleared for clinical decision-making.

hypothesis.statement: In HGSOC, platinum resistance is a property of an intact, HR-proficient genome — often CCNE1-amplified and replication-stress-tolerant — present at diagnosis, before selection. The therapeutic corollary (NOT proven in our data) is that this state is synthetically lethal with agents attacking the replication-stress checkpoint (ATR/WEE1/CHK1) or the CCNE1/CDK2 axis, rather than DNA-damaging agents HR repairs.
hypothesis.proven_boundary: PROVEN: the resistance-associated state (low-s3/HR-proficient/CCNE1-amp ↔ resistance & worse OS). HYPOTHESIS: which drug beats the armor.
hypothesis.negative_bridge: The clonal bottleneck is real, but does NOT select for an emergent armor state (clean negative). Armor is pre-existing.

data_acquisition_verdict: HONEST-NULL for drug response. EGA is byte-authorized for EGAD00001011049 (BriTROC-1 shallow-WGS CN, 679 BAMs); Synapse+ARGO live; SAS/PDS unreachable. No authorized HGSOC cohort with CCNE1/HR annotation AND ATR/WEE1/CDK2i drug-response outcomes is exposed. Therefore every armor drug target stays HYPOTHESIS.

HR_PROFICIENT_CCNE1_ARMOR.definition: Intact homologous recombination (low HRD-axis / low s3) AND/OR CCNE1 amplification (19q12) — a replication-stress-tolerant, HR-proficient genome present at diagnosis, before platinum selection.
HR_PROFICIENT_CCNE1_ARMOR.rationale: A competent HR machine repairs the DNA crosslinks (platinum) and single-ended breaks (PARPi) these agents create, so DNA-damaging therapy is disfavored. The replication-stress checkpoint (ATR/WEE1/CHK1) and the CCNE1/CDK2 axis are the mechanism-rational alternatives (HYPOTHESIS tier — no drug-response cohort in hand).

HRD_PLATINUM_TRACTABLE.definition: HR-deficient genome (high HRD-axis / high s3), e.g. BRCA1/2 or HR-pathway loss — the platinum/PARP-sensitive state.
HRD_PLATINUM_TRACTABLE.rationale: HR deficiency makes the tumor unable to repair platinum crosslinks / PARPi-induced breaks — the validated sensitive state. Platinum and PARP retain weight.

INDETERMINATE.definition: Structural state does not clearly meet either archetype.
INDETERMINATE.rationale: Insufficient structural signal to classify; no re-weighting applied.

axis_drug_sl_map.moa: CDK2 inhibition removes the CCNE1/CDK2-driven proliferative dependency and impairs CDK2-mediated collapsed-fork HR repair in CCNE1-amplified HGSOC.
axis_drug_sl_map.rationale: CCNE1-amplified HGSOC is HR-proficient and platinum-resistant; CDK2 inhibition (BLU-222, dinaciclib) is selectively active in this context.

axis_drug_sl_map.moa: WEE1 inhibition abrogates the G2/M checkpoint, forcing replication-stressed CCNE1-high cells into premature mitosis and mitotic catastrophe.
axis_drug_sl_map.rationale: Cyclin E1 overexpression sensitizes HGSOC to WEE1 inhibition; CCNE1 copy number is a biomarker for WEE1-ATR response.

axis_drug_sl_map.moa: ATR inhibition removes the replication-stress checkpoint that a replication-stress-tolerant, HR-proficient genome relies on, causing fork collapse and double-strand breaks.
axis_drug_sl_map.rationale: ATR inhibition (+/- PARP) overcomes platinum/PARP resistance in HR-proficient and CCNE1-amplified HGSOC models.

axis_drug_sl_map.moa: CHK1 inhibition disables the intra-S/G2 checkpoint, converting endogenous replication stress in CCNE1-high tumors into lethal DNA damage.
axis_drug_sl_map.rationale: CHK1 inhibitor SRA737 is active in PARPi-resistant and CCNE1-amplified HGSOC.

axis_drug_sl_map.moa: PKMYT1 inhibition drives CCNE1-amplified cells into premature, catastrophic mitosis (synthetic lethal with CCNE1 amplification).
axis_drug_sl_map.rationale: CCNE1 amplification is synthetic lethal with PKMYT1 inhibition (Nature 2022).
